title: Two-step sign-in
text: After your password, confirm each sign-in with your phone or a passkey. Someone who learns your password still cannot get in.
due: Set it up by {date} to keep working here.
copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

app.title: Authenticator app
app.text: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or any app that shows 6-digit codes.
app.on: On. Codes from your app confirm each sign-in.
app.setup_text: Scan this code with the app, then type the 6-digit code it shows.
app.qr_alt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
app.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app:
app.remove_text: Its codes stop working. Keep a passkey or set the app up again to stay protected.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.text: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. No password needed, and it cannot be phished.
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys need a secure (https) address and a browser that supports them.
passkeys.add_text: Name it so you recognise it later. Your device will then ask for your fingerprint, face or PIN.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.name_hint: For example: Work laptop, My phone.
passkeys.remove_text: It can no longer sign you in. Remove it from the device too if you no longer use it.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.left_one: {count} code left. Make new ones soon.
codes.left_other: {count} codes left. Each works once if you lose your phone.
codes.new_text: Your old codes stop working at once.
codes.show_text: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.
codes.file_title: Recovery codes. Each works once. Keep them private.
